description: SSH hosts with a terminal + SFTP file manager in one tab, port forwarding (-L / -R), ProxyJump / ProxyCommand. Hosts are stored in a local SQLite database, secrets in the OS keychain.
viewContainer.title: SSHX Studio
view.hosts.welcome:
No hosts yet.
[Add Host](command:sshxStudio.addHost)
[Import from SSH Config](command:sshxStudio.importSshConfig)
config.databasePath: Local SQLite database for hosts and port forwards. Empty = `~/.sshx-studio/sshx.db`. Passwords and private keys are never stored here (they go to the OS keychain).
config.configPath: SSH config file to import hosts from (automatically on first run, or with *Import from SSH Config*). Empty = `~/.ssh/config`.
config.terminalFontSize: Terminal font size in session tabs.
